releases.name: v0.5.0
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **One game, one disc.** Ratchet & Clank is a single game in the launcher, with no region tabs to choose between. The US (NTSC-U) version builds from the same merged tree as the European one, using each version's own code where the two differ.
- **60 Hz for everything.** Every game runs at 60 Hz, and the European game draws in its own 60 Hz mode with its 448-line layout.

releases.name: v0.5.1
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **The launcher updates itself.** When a new release is out it can download and install it from inside the app.
- **One button from a set-up disc to the game.** Once a disc is set up, a single button takes you the rest of the way.

## The game

- **Cutscenes.** In-game cutscenes start, and chained cutscenes play back to back.
- **Ratchet no longer freezes after the wrench throw**, and a thrown wrench leaves his hand.
- **Translucent and glowing objects blend properly**,…

releases.name: v0.5.2
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Linux on ARM64.** There is now a Linux aarch64 build, and the updater supports it.

## The game

- **Ratchet walks at full speed on Rilgar.**
- **Seas draw.** The liquid grid's water, which was missing, is drawn.

The installers are built by the launcher workflow and are not signed for Windows or macOS.

---

Installers built by the launcher workflow from e6642ef5e826456ff073fbfaf347af1d4e8b1ad3.

releases.name: v0.5.3
releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The launcher

- **Flatpak.** The launcher now has a Flathub manifest, metainfo, desktop file and icon, so it can be published there.
- **The updater** works with release files that have spaces in their names.

## For contributors

- A release guide covers GitHub Releases and Flathub.

The installers are built by the launcher workflow and are not signed for Windows or macOS.

releases.author: github-actions[bot]
releases.body:
## The game

- **Shiny things shine.** Metal, chrome and glass on objects are drawn the way the game does it, from the data your disc holds. Parts of textures that are only partly see-through blend properly, cutout textures are sharper, and glows draw their partly transparent pixels.
- **Ratchet holds his weapon properly.** His arms take the stance of the weapon in his hands. The Blaster and the Pyrocitor, whose model had a joint that collapsed, are kept.
- **The Gadgetron vendor looks right.**…
